title: Combatants Will Be Dispatched!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The evil Kisaragi Corporation, close to conquering Earth, sends Combat Agent Six and the android Alice to a fantasy world to scout it for invasion. Drafted into the Kingdom of Grace's army, Six fights a demon army while earning 'Evil Points' through dishonorable and lecherous acts, which buy him equipment. A comedy adapted from the light novel by the author of KONOSUBA.
life_message: The story jokes that open self-interest and dirty tricks get results where noble heroics fail.

content.note: Battles with a demon army using guns and tech (Wikipedia; AniList War, Guns); largely comic per MU Comedic Violence.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Six answers slights with tricks and retaliation (Wikipedia).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Six ignores rules, chasing Evil Points (Wikipedia).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Loyalty is to Kisaragi bosses Six shares a past with (Wikipedia).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Corporate ranks exist but are treated irreverently.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Science-fiction corporation versus fantasy kingdom; secular joking tone.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Indulgence and personal gain over duty.

folkways.japan: The comedy parodies the isekai and tokusatsu villain-henchman traditions familiar in Japanese media, and the reluctant-employee joke reflects Japanese company culture.

delivery.evidence: ANN reviewers read it as derivative trope parody; one sees Six's snark as the author's own worldview.
delivery.note: The story argues by joke rather than speech, siding with its self-serving hero over idealistic fantasy heroes.

winners_losers: Six and Kisaragi gain while the demon army loses; sympathy goes to the cynical hero, and women characters bear the cost of his jokes.
